annotation_revision: RXRA and DNMT3A transcript-reference citations corrected after the recorded API execution, retaining the printed report labels separately; no AlphaGenome or other prediction values changed and no live API call was made for these corrections.

embedding_reproduction.out_of_distribution_caveat: AlphaGenome 2 CellConditioningInput expects integer single-cell UMI counts. vendor-transformed-expression.tsv is bulk FFPE WTS transformed expression from a liver-metastasis biopsy reported at 60-70% histological tumour cellularity; histological cellularity does NOT measure the malignant vs non-malignant RNA transcript mixture fraction. Pseudo-UMI conditioning is therefore an out-of-distribution exploratory prior, not a single-cell malignant measurement.

fresh_live_api_tables.scope: Unconditionally queried and regenerated from live AlphaGenome 2 + Atlas APIs whenever --execute is run.

imputation_and_unit_policy.missing_imputation_disclosure: For reference ontology conditions in variant-track-scores.tsv.gz and interval-track-scores.tsv.gz, imputation_mode is copied verbatim from the retained target-gene rows of the AlphaGenome 2 API response. For the 30 user-supplied pseudoUMI_cell rows (cell_conditioning), the API returns NaN for imputation_mode; those 30 rows are explicitly marked 'unavailable_for_cell_conditioning'.

separate_scorer_units.obs_splice_junctions_max_log_diff: max |log(ALT) - log(REF)| splice-junction read count across observed tracks
separate_scorer_units.obs_splice_sites_max_prob_diff: max |ALT - REF| splice-site classification probability across observed tracks
separate_scorer_units.obs_splice_usage_max_frac_diff: max |ALT - REF| splice-site usage fraction across observed tracks

imputation_and_unit_policy.splicing_variant_scoring_policy: Splicing variant scorers (SPLICE_SITES, SPLICE_SITE_USAGE, SPLICE_JUNCTIONS) are requested only on bulk-RNA reference tissues (pancreas, liver, lung) and are NOT requested on single-cell-only conditions (ductal, peritoneum) where all splicing channels are imputed_exploratory. Within the bulk-RNA tissue responses, variant-track-scores.tsv.gz retains all target-gene track rows (matching the focal Ensembl ID or gene symbol across observed, imputed_supported and imputed_exploratory channels) with their explicit imputation_mode labels for auditability, while summary columns in ctdna-progression-audit.tsv filter strictly to imputation_mode == 'observed'.
imputation_and_unit_policy.supported_conditions_semantics: client.supported_conditions() reports only the best imputation_mode across channels of an output type in AlphaGenome 2's reference training corpus ('observed' means >=1 channel was measured in reference biosamples, not all channels and never a measurement in Yash's tissue).

inherited_frozen_tables.scope: Checksum-verified tables inherited from the initial AlphaGenome 2 run (not regenerated by --execute).

interpretation: AlphaGenome 2 and Atlas outputs are reference-genome regulatory/pathogenicity predictions, not patient biopsy measurements across unbiopsied lung or peritoneal lesions, not proof of splice neutrality or normal-organ silence, and not clinical safety or immunogenicity evidence.
long_gene_window_limit: 30 of 32 profiled genes receive both RNA_SEQ and SC_GENE_EXPRESSION interval scores; NRG1 (1.216 Mb) and ERBB4 (1.164 Mb) exceed AlphaGenome 2's 1,048,576-bp sequence / 200,001-bp GeneMaskScorer window, leaving single-cell 3'-end mask columns blank while bulk RNA_SEQ columns remain populated.
